author: janwrites
body:
![jr-korpa-N8OcpX-zK6s-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janwrites/23zaj83wAYEL1r1EEbZrFqZ2mPpFYcFpMWze9fGszzwDHLxdpD8GiLktCuEMTCPu9efZ6.jpg)


I’ve never shared this online before. 

A few close friends know about it, but we didn’t really dive into it. Maybe writing it down will help me untangle the mystery...or maybe not. At least I tried.

This happened 27 years ago when I was in first grade at Lipata Central School. It’s one of the reasons I believe in the paranormal even if it doesn't make any sense.

## It was lunch break

...and my yaya (nanny) had just bought me a slice of chiffon cake. I’ve always been a sentimental kid, so instead of eating it right away, I decided to save it. I tied the cellophane-wrapped cake to my bag, thinking it would remind me of her for the rest of the day. I waved goodbye as she left, then went off to play with my classmates.

Our school was spacious back then, with classrooms scattered across open grounds instead of being in a single building. My classroom was part of a newer JICA block donated by Japan. Across from it were older classrooms, where we decided to hang out that day.

One of my friends found a strange spot behind one of those old classrooms. The ground there was “bouncy.” It looked like regular dirt, but when we jumped on it, it felt like a trampoline. Naturally, we were intrigued. I even sat down to inspect it, wondering if something like a buried basketball was making it springy.

Eventually, we got bored with it and parted ways. I started heading back to my classroom, but then everything shifted.

## Suddenly, it was like I was in a dream... 

People started running in my direction, their faces filled with panic. It was as if some disaster had struck behind me, and I was the only one standing still.

I froze, trying to make sense of it. 

The chaos was overwhelming... students gasping, some boys yelling, feet pounding the ground. I thought I heard someone shout something about a lion and a dog “boxing.” Yes, *boxing*. It made no sense, but I still can remember clearly the exact words.

## What made it even more surreal 

...was how everyone I looked at would go from acting normal... walking, chatting... to suddenly sprinting in my direction in panic the moment my eyes laid on them.

It was like my gaze triggered their fear. It felt like a lucid dream where things change when I focus on them. I started crying, overwhelmed and terrified, as older kids pushed past me. My tiny frame was no match for the stampede.

Except for that day, I've never experienced a stampede in my entire life. To this day, I can still feel the weight of those shoulders pushing against mine.

I stumbled forward, running against the crowd, desperate for help. That’s when I saw her, a girl heading in the same direction as me, the only one not running away. 

## In my panic, I grabbed her skirt and clung to it like my life depended on it. 

I even got dragged a few steps, scraping my arms on the ground.

She stopped, startled, sat down trying to help me up. "What happened?" she asked, alarmed.

Through tears, I remember blurting out, *"Ana sila naay lion ug iro na nag-boxing!"* (They said a lion and a dog were boxing!)

She looked at me, clearly confused, but she crouched down and tried to calm me. "No, there’s no lion and dog boxing," she said trying to convince me, putting my arm over her shoulder to help me stand. 

"Where are they running to?"
"Nobody's running"

And then—everything went black.

When I came to, my eyes still closed, I heard voices. "She passed out," the girl whispered. It was the first time I heard the word. *Kuyapan* (fainting) was not yet a familiar word to me..

## When I opened my eyes, I was in a dark classroom with no lights on. 

It was one of those old classrooms right across mine. The door was open and I could make sense of the time from the afternoon hues. There were three students sitting on the front row seats, waiting for me to wake up. 

Three kids sat in the front row, near the door: two girls and a boy. They watched me intently, waiting for me to wake up. Their uniforms were neat and they looked at me in silence, as if waiting for me to tell them what the heck happened.

I sat up, disoriented. My first thought was that I was late for class. Mrs. Medida, my teacher, had a reputation for being strict, and I dreaded the scolding I was sure to get. Without saying a word to the three kids (who had waited for me the entire afternoon!) I jumped off the teacher's table (it was quite high) and I bolted out of the classroom.

I didn't even get the chance to thank them. They waited for me the entire afternoon on that dark Grade 3 classroom, probably excited to hear my story, looking after me until I woke up. 

As I ran across the open space to my room, I glanced at the sky. I remember the orange-pink hues that reminded me how late I was. 

![seny-g-AQxmPtgXWJs-unsplash (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janwrites/23tmcpiwV5mp9zgJdu7c9z8Krg6QkZCHYoZWBWSA7wApwBj1M4y6i5bya6SoHAQK3uAKX.jpg)


When I walked in, bracing for some scolding, my teacher continued with her lesson as if she hadn't seen me. It was unusual, but I sighed in relief as I got to my seat. She continued her lesson like nobody just came in without explanation.

I sank into my seat, heart pounding. I looked at my bag, and remembered feeling a bit sad when my chiffon cake was no longer there. Glancing at the clock, I realized it was almost 5 p.m. I’d been unconscious for nearly four hours. I waited until the rest of the class for anyone to mention something significant happened that day, the day went on as usual.

## A strange silence in me.

There was a strange silence in me that afternoon that I couldn't even share what happened to anyone because it was too huge for my tiny mind to grasp. I felt that I didn't even know where to start or what to make of it.

Over the years, I've grown more attuned to signs. In certain places, I instinctively feel the need to be cautious, even without a clear reason. It's almost as if I can sense when a large tree or a particular spot in nature is home to something unseen.

I haven’t developed any paranormal abilities or “gifts,” but this experience has led me to believe there’s more to the world than what meets the eye.

## For years, I didn’t think much about the details. 

It was just a bizarre memory I rarely revisited.
I went back to the school 10 years ago hoping to find answers, but a lot has changed. The old classrooms were no longer there and it also was too late in the afternoon that I didn't take the risk to search around for that bouncy spot.

I know it's been 27 years but this was a very vivid memory. Trust me that I was so sure that this wasn't a false memory of a dream, I was there and the surreal happened. 

I didn't try to recall it that much over the years to spot for loose ends, it's just how far my memory went. However, it was only until recently that I realized that something was off with my story.

Who are those 3 kids, why were they not in their classes? 

How were they able to lift me up to the teacher's table and waited for me as I slept, sitting in a dark classroom with no lights and fans on? How were they able to guard me for roughly 4 hours without telling my teacher about it (my classroom was just right across that old room and I had an ID)?

The more I think about it, the stranger it feels. They looked perfectly normal... just kids in uniforms. But the longer I dwell on it, the more I’m convinced there was something... not quite human about them.

Even now, as I write this, it sends chills down my spine. 
What happened to me?

---

body:
*This guide will help you get started with Hive and Cur8, providing the tools and knowledge you need to create, share, and earn as a content creator*


![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbr8FNJsULyBFd2wLBXRkPGAMSeZKc78oxSHgDyk3FEXF/image.png)


## What is Hive and How Can It Help You Earn?

**Hive** is a blockchain-based social network that rewards users for creating and sharing original and valuable content. By publishing articles, stories, photos, and other interesting content, you can earn cryptocurrency rewards based on the votes received from the community.
These rewards come in the form of HIVE, a type of cryptocurrency, the more votes and support your post gets from the community, the more you earn.

*If you want to learn more about the technical side of Hive, I recommend you to read the official whitepaper: https://hive.io/whitepaper.pdf*

---

## Peakd and Cur8

[Peakd](https://www.peakd.com) is one of the main platform for the Hive blockchain, where you can read posts, leave comments, manage you funds and fully enjoy the social experience.

[Cur8](https://www.cur8hive.surge.sh), on the other hand, focuses on optimizing curation returns for our delegators and developing content creation tools for authors in order to simplify and improve the posting process.


![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTLV3ADvSoK8whfkto6CAjzBxmBHhTYRCDNH8h86EkMqd/image.png)

---

## What is Cur8?

**Cur8** is a curator dedicated to the Hive blockchain. Thanks to our delegators, we are building a community of passionate writers and readers. Our mission is to enhance the Hive ecosystem by bringing in new users, educating them, and supporting both newcomers and experienced users.

To achieve this, we provide valuable tools like our new [Telegram mini app](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot), designed to simplify and improve the posting experience on Hive.

<center>
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWUcZAApcjtCaLWxB4NjggrGJMnCE9ee7RpqYVd2Nsdcb/image.jpeg)
</center>

---

## Creating Your Hive Account

With our [Telegram bot](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot), you can easily create a free Hive account. Important: Once your account is created, **REMEMBER TO SAVE YOUR PRIVATE KEYS** – without them, you won’t be able to access your account in the future!

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV26htVi5EpZ39NF5oNrjUyvavjZRqP5RQneiCZ81PoCM/image.gif)</center>

*If you already have an Hive account, you can skip this process and log in directly to the [web app](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot).*

---

## What are Keys for?

Private keys are essential for accessing and managing your account securely. Each key serves a specific purpose, offering varying levels of access and functionalities:

**Master Key**: Full account control and recovery. Keep offline and secure.

**Owner Key**: Used to reset keys and regain account control.

**Active Key**: For transferring funds and managing account settings.

**Posting Key**: For posts, voting, and commenting.

**Memo Key**: For encrypting private messages during transfers.

---

## Login to Cur8 Posting Mini App

To access our Telegram app open [Cur8 bot](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot), start the bot, and simply click the **APP** button in the bottom left corner, then you can choose between two login methods:

- Login via Hivesigner with the **Active key**: This method is more reliable and requires the Active key to grant Cur8 posting authorization.

- Login with the **Posting key**: This is the direct method provided by the app. The key will be encrypted and never shared.

<center>![Immagine](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWyqTH3Ewqy2juZrGCN6akdQHBvSfvKKkwpiKy3GGwqeK/image.gif)</center>

---

## Exploring Our Web App

The web app is simple and intuitive, offering:

- **Account Management**: Manage and add your Hive accounts, select one for posting, or log out.

- **Publish**: Create posts with titles, content, tags, images, GIFs, and select a community.

- **Drafts**: Review, edit, and publish saved posts.

- **Settings**: Customize theme and language for each account.


![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU4WRsgEWkwEaZZpDC7Sp42gARLKn3mCpqUdnZwD3mtNR/image.png)

![Immagine](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXfN146AdXCg4xetWWBbsuTzM2hQFsMnSEEboCJS792EN/image.png)



**Key features also include**:

**Post Scheduling**: Publish at a chosen time.

**Save Drafts**: Work on content at your own pace.

**Preview**: See your post before publishing.

**Markdown Tools**: Easily format and style your text.



`You'll find some useful tutorials in the Telegram bot menu!`


---

## Your first post on Hive

Your first post is very important as it acts as your introduction to the community and sets the tone for your account. A well-crafted first post can help you start on the right foot and attract attention from other users.

Take some time to explore [Peakd](https://www.peakd.com), browse through the [communities](https://peakd.com/communities), and check out posts from other authors to get a feel for the platform.

To create your post with the [Cur8 App](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot), go to the **Publish** section. Add a title, write your content in the body, and choose relevant tags. The first tag is the most important, you can use "introduceyourself" to maximize visibility for your introduction. Use the preview button to see how your post will look and choose a community where you would publish your content, then click Publish Now and confirm to share it with the world.


<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVSJDcHwuuaS2QnZHdHDebYcKpubJo3Wd7WewV3xxjRiU/image.jpeg)</center>

*(Learn Markdown to make your posts more engaging. [Here's a quick guide](https://peakd.com/markdown/@gmuxx/a-beginner-s-guide-to-markdown))*

## How to schedule a post

Scheduled posts are an excellent tool for planning your content in advance. Whether you're targeting a specific time zone or preparing a campaign, scheduling ensures your posts go live exactly when you want.
Here's how to schedule a post using the [Cur8 App](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot):

- **Fill Out the Post Details**: Begin by creating your post as you would normally. Add a title, content, tags, and select a community.

- **Choose the Scheduled Time**: Tap on the clock icon, select the date and time for your post to be published. Make sure to double-check the time to ensure accuracy.

- **Confirm and Save**: After selecting the desired time, confirm your choice. Then, save your post.

- **Check the Scheduled Tab**: Your post will now appear in the Scheduled tab under the Drafts menu.

- **Automatic Publishing**: At the scheduled time, the system will automatically publish your post to the Hive blockchain. No further action is required from your side.

<center>![Immagine](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcSBZARNhc622Q2rg92dLTH91PmjXWW2LX4PUCZR2nRAn/image.gif)</center>


## Tips for Earning Successfully on Hive

Getting started with publishing is easy, but to achieve good results, follow these practical tips and community guidelines:

**Avoid plagiarism and low-quality content**: Hive rewards original content. Don’t copy from other sources without crediting and aim to create high-value content.

**Limit the use of AI tools**: AI-generated content is often frowned upon. Focus on authentic, original creations.

**Learn the communities**: Each Hive community has specific rules. Participate in initiatives, follow the guidelines, and join contests to gain recognition from curators.

**Be active and participate**: Engage with others, join contests, and involve yourself in community activities.

**Don’t give up**: The beginning can be tough, but with persistence and dedication, you’ll find your space.

**Comment and interact**: Leave meaningful comments on other posts to gain visibility and build a good reputation.

**Don’t hesitate to ask for help**: Moderators and experienced users can assist you with rules and doubts.

**Create original and quality content**: Hive curators are always on the lookout for interesting posts to reward.

---

*With our web app, you have all the tools to start publishing and earning. Have fun and good luck on Hive!*


<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU3sehxQkekaasxxRmNwQ5RTRfyy4kuPcMHM6gC6sqA8o/image.png)</center>

<center>[**WEBSITE**](https://www.cur8hive.surge.sh)  |  [**TELEGRAM APP**](https://t.me/cur8_hiveBot)  |  [**TON SWAP**](https://t.me/Cur8TonSwapBot)  |  [**RESOURCES**](https://t.me/cur8_earn)  |  [**SUPPORT**](https://t.me/cur8support)</center>

author: hylene74
body:
https://img.inleo.io/DQmU7aHe8set93G3d1daG525eeM4yJgeMwoMGV4RWCyTe6U/volunteer-2654004_1280.jpg [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/volunteer-hands-voluntarily-help-2654004/)
#
[ESP]
Saludos estimados amigos de #hiveargentina, el trabajo del voluntariado es una labor muy noble e invaluable. No he pertenecido a grupos de voluntarios formales, pero si he colaborado con ellos y he participado en actividades en pro de ayudar al prójimo.
De conocer grupos activos en mi ciudad solo los que ayudan a los animalitos en condición de calle, siempre he sentido amor y compasión por los animales, así que apenas vi en facebook que habían creado fundaciones para ayudar a perros y gatos sin hogar, me uní a ellos. Sé que existe un grupo de la Cruz Roja y la Misión Nevado, este último sé que se encuentra activo en algunas ciudades.
![IMG_20241231_154008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/23vi5wRUDQf7hz86sAgu5V7cQ7xaBq6BZaPfCFqvV2Wubu53FGtQACPTRA1xhbEngFCtR.jpg) Fotografía original de mi álbum personal
Tuve la oportunidad de participar en actividades con algunas fundaciones para ayudar a perros y gatos, como en jornadas de adopción, donativos de alimentos y censos para futuras esterilizaciones. Por mi cuenta también he sido proteccionista de perros y gatos, los he ayudado con mis propios recursos y cuando no puedo sola, he pedido ayuda a las fundaciones. En mi lugar de trabajo, justo en el mes de diciembre realizaban recolecta de alimentos no perecederos para llevarlo a las zonas de bajos recursos. Por otra parte, hacían una jornada de entrega de juguetes para niños huérfanos que están siendo cuidados en una casa hogar. Siempre me ha gustado participar como voluntaria, he pensando incluso pertenecer a un grupo, pero me he dado cuenta que hace falta tiempo de calidad y es algo que tengo limitado por mi trabajo.
![IMG_20241231_144049.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/23uQtiLhN6MGBGhofbhZAEApfUTC1qhWWELM5ykqpmdxMiodSuSZX5BD5RfMCGduYLYqN.jpg) Fotografía original, tomada con mi celular Xiaomi Redmi 9
Confieso que me gusta ser voluntaria para aportar mi granito de arena, así que siempre que puedo participo en ese tipo de actividades. En Hive estuve con un grupo para donar ropa en una zona económicamente vulnerable en mi ciudad, fue una iniciativa de la comunidad Red Carpet.
El trabajo voluntario significa que es algo que nace de corazón, sin pedir nada a cambio, de igual manera si hay un gesto de agradecimiento por tal labor será siempre bienvenido y no necesariamente se trata de dinero. Si los voluntarios recibieran sueldo, su trabajo perderla la connotación de voluntarios. Pienso que la mayor recompensa en el trabajo voluntario es ver felices a quienes reciben la ayuda, además de lo que retribuye la misma vida con tales acciones respecto a ese dar infinito.
![IMG_20241231_145005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/243WgGiRrbfzyzENWbJEAXSsAe3PRjX2y4qZtMAVeE3W2kz8ogGvM74Sue8XrHMEkP6GB.jpg) [Fuente mi blog de Hive](https://hive.blog/hive-172958/@hylene74/cuando-la-moda-se-trata-de-regalar-sonrisas-esp-eng)
El trabajo voluntario en mi opinión hace falta en muchas partes del mundo y por eso considero que más grupos deben formarse para ayudar a quienes lo necesitan, más personas ayudando de manera desinteresada definitivamente construirán con un mundo mejor. Los voluntarios no son héroes, son personas normales con un alma noble y bondadosa, sin importar la hora y el lugar, siempre están dispuestos a dar, y estar. Para ser voluntarios hay que tener un gran corazón. Ser voluntaria es algo que nace y se siente. Invito a participar a @trimer2023 y @maydelvalle.
# Gracias por leer
https://img.inleo.io/DQmU7aHe8set93G3d1daG525eeM4yJgeMwoMGV4RWCyTe6U/volunteer-2654004_1280.jpg [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/volunteer-hands-voluntarily-help-2654004/)
#
[ENG]
Greetings dear friends of #hiveargentina, volunteer work is a very noble and invaluable work. I have not belonged to formal volunteer groups, but I have collaborated with them and I have participated in activities to help others.
I have always felt love and compassion for animals, so as soon as I saw on facebook that they had created foundations to help homeless dogs and cats, I joined them. I know that there is a group of the Red Cross and the Nevado Mission, the latter I know is active in some cities.
![IMG_20241231_154008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/23vi5wRUDQf7hz86sAgu5V7cQ7xaBq6BZaPfCFqvV2Wubu53FGtQACPTRA1xhbEngFCtR.jpg) Original photo from my personal album
I had the opportunity to participate in activities with some foundations to help dogs and cats, such as adoption days, food donations and census for future sterilizations. On my own I have also been a dog and cat protectionist, I have helped them with my own resources and when I can't do it alone, I have asked for help from foundations. At my place of work, just in the month of December, they used to collect non-perishable food to take it to low-income areas. On the other hand, they had a toy delivery day for orphaned children who are being cared for in a children's home. I have always liked to participate as a volunteer, I have even thought about belonging to a group, but I have realized that I need quality time and it is something that I have limited because of my work.
![IMG_20241231_144049.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/23uQtiLhN6MGBGhofbhZAEApfUTC1qhWWELM5ykqpmdxMiodSuSZX5BD5RfMCGduYLYqN.jpg) Original photo, taken with my Xiaomi Redmi 9 cell phone
I confess that I like to volunteer to do my bit, so whenever I can I participate in these types of activities. In Hive I was with a group to donate clothes in an economically vulnerable area in my city, it was an initiative of the Red Carpet community.
Volunteer work means that it is something that is born from the heart, without asking for anything in return, likewise if there is a gesture of gratitude for such work will always be welcome and it is not necessarily about money. If volunteers were paid, their work would lose the connotation of volunteerism. I think that the greatest reward in volunteer work is to see those who receive the help happy, in addition to what life itself rewards with such actions with respect to that infinite giving..
![IMG_20241231_145005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hylene74/243WgGiRrbfzyzENWbJEAXSsAe3PRjX2y4qZtMAVeE3W2kz8ogGvM74Sue8XrHMEkP6GB.jpg) [Source my Hive blog](https://hive.blog/hive-172958/@hylene74/cuando-la-moda-se-trata-de-regalar-sonrisas-esp-eng)
Volunteer work in my opinion is lacking in many parts of the world and that is why I believe that more groups should be formed to help those in need, more people helping in a selfless way will definitely build a better world. Volunteers are not heroes, they are normal people with a noble and kind soul, no matter the time and place, they are always willing to give, and to be. To be a volunteer you have to have a big heart. Being a volunteer is something that is born and felt. I invite @trimer2023 and @maydelvalle to participate
# Thank you for reading
All photos are original, taken with my Xiaomi Redmi 9 cell phone

author: radiogaga
body:
Українська діаспора Канади – це ціла історія, це кілька епох та поколінь. Не дивлячись на час, вона свято оберігає та плекає у наступних поколіннях все українське: мову, звичаї, традиції, пісні. А в час важких випробувань для України ця діаспора робить максимум можливого, щоб допомогти Україні та людям, що тут живуть.
Час важких випробувань продовжується майже три роки. Війна за визволення з-під окупаційного чобота росіянців рідної землі триває, ставлячи нові і нові задачі для кожного небайдужого.
І ось, 8-річна канадська співачка українського походження Злата Барчук випускає новий кліп «Колискова мелодія України».  Пісня присвячена  всім невинно загиблим дітям України під час війни. Її прем’єра відбулася ще у вересні цього року, але кліп вийшов саме тепер.
Його неможливо дивитися без сліз. Тут прокручуються жорстокі кажри бомбардувань мирних міст, тут ми згадаємо і про загиблих дітей, яких не змогли врятувати лікарі. 
Голос дівчинки із Канади звучить надзвичайно щемливо на фоні цих картин. Такі вони, реалії війни…

Злата почала співати на великій сцені вже у свої маленькі три рочки. Зараз дівчинка навчається у вокальній студії Олени Луценко та Лаури Каваче. Не дивлячись на юний вік, Злата вже є переможцем багатьох канадських та міжнародних вокальних конкурсів. Свої пісні дівчинка виконує англійською та українською мовами, що дозволяє унікально представляти Україну, її традиції та культуру. Злата любить співати, вона із задоволенням бере участь у різноманітних концертах, де часто підтримує Україну. А ще Злата веде свою музичну програму на українському ТБ Контакт Next Generation.

author: mamaemigrante
body:
https://img.inleo.io/DQmYrW8UhBfpuQifPWTRvJnqa7tL4ci57mLAd229u9d4pyJ/pexels-rdne-6646816.jpg
[ RDNE Stock project - Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/manos-amor-africa-viaje-6646816/) Cuando hablamos de voluntariado, si lo preguntáramos en una sala llena, creo que serían pocos los que alzarían la mano diciendo que lo han hecho en algún momento de su vida, pues pareciera que ayudar a los demás es solo trabajo de los gobiernos, o de la iglesia. Pero la realidad es, que ser voluntario no es solo una manera de expiar culpas o tratar de ganarse escalones directo al cielo. Realmente quienes hacen esta labor, son personas como cualquier otra, pero con un toque especial en el alma, que los lleva a ayudar sin pedir nada a cambio. Recuerdo en mi época de docente universitario, cuando me tocaba guiar a los alumnos en el proceso de su servicio comunitario obligatorio. Al inicio,todos lo veían como algo fastidioso que debían hacer para poder aprobar ese requisito, pero ya luego, cuando guiados por los docentes encargados iban y se enfrentaban a realidades que no conocían, algo pasaba en su interior.
https://img.inleo.io/DQmdCXCZCSMGLUC9QkYTC8RXEGUisraE3xmNo6z4MNbMBpM/pexels-thirdman-7656743.jpg
[Thirdman - Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/hombre-mujer-rio-limpieza-7656743/) Era maravilloso poder ver ese cambio de mentalidad, aunque luego de aprobar no siguieran en el voluntariado propiamente, pero si se activaba una célula dormida, sobre la importancia de ponerse en los zapatos de otro, y para mi, eso era más que suficiente. Un voluntario no es un héroe como tal, aunque quienes reciben esas gotas de amor, probablemente si lo vean de esa forma, ya que recibir de la mano de un desconocido esa ayuda que estás procurando, puede ser la demostración directa de que Dios si existe, inclusive para los que se catalogan como ateos. Voluntario proviene de voluntad, por lo que no tiene un valor monetario, sino las ganas y el entusiasmo de hacer el bien, sea aportando tu esfuerzo, tu tiempo o los recursos que tengas a la mano. Esto no quiere decir que donar dinero sea trabajo voluntario, pues es necesario involucrarse también emocionalmente.
https://img.inleo.io/DQmZsSAbqmgPMLz7nSsZ7SHK7DmvxcjbfcxCjk1sCCZnab4/pexels-givingtuesday-9826021.jpg
[GivingTuesday - Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/gente-en-pie-de-pie-sujetando-9826021/) Somos afortunados quienes no hemos necesitado de la ayuda de los voluntarios de cualquier organización grande o chica! Pero no quiere decir que estemos exentos de que esto pueda suceder en algún momento, por eso siempre he sido de los que piensan que es mejor andar por la vida ayudando desinteresadamente, ya que el universo ve nuestras acciones y quizás esas recompensas que logramos son el pago por todo el bien que le hemos hecho a los demás. Los voluntarios no tienen un sueldo, quizás tampoco grandes fortunas, pero de seguro viven con la felicidad de poder ayudar a otros, y ya la vida los compensa de otras formas, logrando ese equilibrio tan necesario en la sociedad actual.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmadG2aMuYuqU82cCa9NpTsW9tiKKE5uJ8N91Tw6SKatLc/image.png
When we talk about volunteering, if we were to ask in a full room, I think few would raise their hands saying that they have done it at some point in their lives, because it seems that helping others is only the job of governments or the church. But the reality is that volunteering is not just a way to atone for guilt or try to earn steps straight to heaven. In reality, those who do this work are people like any other, but with a special touch in their souls that leads them to help without asking for anything in return. I remember in my time as a university professor, when I had to guide students in the process of their mandatory community service. At the beginning, they all saw it as something annoying that they had to do in order to pass that requirement, but later, when guided by the teachers in charge, they went and faced realities that they did not know, something happened inside them.
https://img.inleo.io/DQmdCXCZCSMGLUC9QkYTC8RXEGUisraE3xmNo6z4MNbMBpM/pexels-thirdman-7656743.jpg
[Thirdman - Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/hombre-mujer-rio-limpieza-7656743/) It was wonderful to see that change of mentality, even if after passing the requirement they did not continue volunteering, but it activated a dormant cell, about the importance of putting themselves in someone else's shoes, and for me, that was more than enough. A volunteer is not a hero as such, although those who receive those drops of love, probably see it that way, since receiving from the hand of a stranger that help you are seeking, can be a direct demonstration that God does exist, even for those who are classified as atheists. Volunteerism comes from willpower, so it does not have a monetary value, but the desire and enthusiasm to do good, either by contributing your effort, your time or the resources you have at hand. This does not mean that donating money is voluntary work, since it is necessary to get involved emotionally as well.
https://img.inleo.io/DQmZsSAbqmgPMLz7nSsZ7SHK7DmvxcjbfcxCjk1sCCZnab4/pexels-givingtuesday-9826021.jpg
[GivingTuesday - Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/gente-en-pie-de-pie-sujetando-9826021/) We are fortunate that we have not needed the help of volunteers from any organization, big or small! But it does not mean that we are exempt from this happening at some point, so I have always been one of those who think it is better to go through life helping selflessly, because the universe sees our actions and perhaps those rewards we achieve are the payment for all the good we have done to others. Volunteers do not have a salary, perhaps not even great fortunes, but they surely live with the happiness of being able to help others, and life compensates them in other ways, achieving that balance so necessary in today's society. *** Foto/Photo by: RDNE stock project, Thirdman and Giving Tuesday (all from Pexels) Edición/Edited by @mamaemigrante [Tattooworld animated banner](https://www.textstudio.com/) Translated and formatted with [Hive Translator](https://hivetranslator.com) by @noakmilo. ![Tattoo-World-16-5-2023.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyunasantacruz/EoeFSdmKzY4uYhMverEFdgXuPskgcde7KRFt2jg8EY3NbXcM4nAzRwhXTdgCqR7gvTK.gif) Posted Using [InLeo Alpha](https://inleo.io/@mamaemigrante/trabajo-voluntario-un-grano-de-arena-que-fabrica-castillos-volunteer-work-a-grain-of-sand-that-builds-castles-5x4)

author: rosmiapure
body:
![Añadir un título (3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rosmiapure/23w38EidSqnrAU8VmLWDzMAB6eWWZNJUVhEEXFczudV9YF2tEKDXn7GNh8jEMKmjxzfnQ.png)
No se si alguno de ustedes recuerda que aproximadamente hace un mes hice un post para solicitar de su apoyo para continuar con el proceso para la operación de mi tía, quien en ese momento se encontraba pasando por el proceso de hacerse varios exámenes para posterior a eso realizarse una cirugía. Les dejo el link de ese post por [aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-110011/@rosmiapure/solicitando-de-su-apoyo-para-continuar-con-el-proceso-para-la-operacion-de-mi-tia-espeng) En esta oportunidad vengo nuevamente a solicitar de todo el apoyo que esté al alcance y que puedan prestarnos, ya que, lo que considerábamos que no excedería nuestra expectativa, lo hizo. Resulta que para los primeros de diciembre nos hicieron la entrega de los resultados de la Biopsia, los cuales fueron revisados por la ginecóloga que trata a mi tía y para ese entonces le comento que los resultados no eran nada favorables y que no le gustaban por lo que solicito que se hiciera una Tomografía con contraste y la refirió con un oncólogo para verificar la información que hasta el momento se manejaba. A continuación, comparto imágenes del resultado de la biopsia. > I don't know if any of you remember that about a month ago I made a post to ask for your support to continue with the process for the operation of my aunt, who at that time was going through the process of having several tests to perform surgery after that. I leave you the link of that post [here](https://peakd.com/hive-110011/@rosmiapure/requesting-your-support-to-continue-with-the-process-for-my-aunt's-operation-espeng). > >In this opportunity I come again to ask for all the support that is within reach and that you can lend us, since, what we considered that it would not exceed our expectations, it did. > >It turns out that at the beginning of December we received the results of the Biopsy, which were reviewed by the gynecologist who treats my aunt and at that time I told her that the results were not at all favorable and that she did not like them, so she requested a CT scan with contrast and referred her to an oncologist to verify the information that had been handled up to that moment. > >Below, I share images of the biopsy results.
![Imagen de WhatsApp 2024-12-07 a las 09.04.07_7e7000ce.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rosmiapure/23x17Do3P1cHdHpyHU6UKzpbKpbnZFyPGWHGUi4Cd33xJcK8j6XPC5GFB6giF681gcM7E.jpg)
![Imagen de WhatsApp 2024-12-07 a las 09.04.25_769ed221.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rosmiapure/23wgMqqysAnTTcs2NwJ3ZVDY4thmueS3HfRWgAK8eDJAT2Zia643ixpTcbxLxLGbwWprP.jpg)
Contactamos con el oncólogo que va hasta Amazonas para evaluar pacientes y, el cual se encuentra en Valencia y lo que nos recomendó de emergencia fue que se hiciera una resonancia de pelvis con contraste, ya que al parecer este tipo de examen es mucho más específico y confiable. Entre la familia nos reunimos y con una parte de lo recogido con el post que les mencioné, también ubicamos algún conocido en Valencia para que recibiera a mis tíos para que pudiesen ahorrarse lo del hospedaje y así fue como hicimos para que ellos pudiesen ir hasta allá a hacerse ese estudio. A continuación, comparto imágenes del estudio que se realizó mi tía en Valencia: > We contacted the oncologist who goes to Amazonas to evaluate patients and he is in Valencia and what he recommended us as an emergency was to have an MRI of the pelvis with contrast, since it seems that this type of test is much more specific and reliable. > > Among the family we got together and with part of the money collected with the post I mentioned, we also found someone in Valencia to receive my aunt and uncle so they could save on lodging and that was how we did so that they could go there to have the study done. > > Below, I share pictures of the study that my aunt had in Valencia:
![Imagen de WhatsApp 2024-12-27 a las 18.10.13_beb9a66c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rosmiapure/23uFTrLqXPT2LH42WRmsVT64CPL7brx2w84ECqJTcg6GYV6Zreskm2LFpKVjMMFqFkzhB.jpg)
![Imagen de WhatsApp 2024-12-27 a las 18.10.15_1d1ccc1e.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rosmiapure/23wgajWNAgGuTrjC37HcV8R1mBkxGGmp2z9ocuubgubSQnfTyjkrWHenfRQfz6xCWgpxX.jpg)
---
Recibimos estos resultados de la Resonancia, los cuales tuvimos que esperar un tiempo considerado para que el doctor los leyera, interpretara y nos pudiese dar esa noticia que ningún familiar desearía escuchar acerca de ese ser que ama, y, es que el resultado final confirma lo que la ginecóloga sospechaba y quería descartar con este tipo de estudio y a que, sí, mi tía tiene Cáncer en el endometrio con otra pequeña complicación y, sí, esta noticia nos ha pegado muy mal a todos, incluyéndola a ella porque su mamá (mi abuela) murió a causa del cáncer a pesar de todos los esfuerzos que hicimos en su momento para eliminar esa enfermedad de su cuerpo. No todo es malo, porque tenemos la oportunidad de realizar una operación donde le extraigan todo y las posibilidades de eliminar el cáncer desde la raíz son suficientemente grandes, ya que el doctor dice que afortunadamente esta mala enfermedad se encuentra concentrada en el endometrio y no se ha expandido a otras zonas, lo que realmente es muy bueno y brinda algo de aliento. A continuación, comparto imagen del resultado final definido por el doctor: > We received these results of the MRI, which we had to wait a considerable time for the doctor to read them, interpret them and give us the news that no family member would want to hear about that being they love, and, the final result confirms what the gynecologist suspected and wanted to rule out with this type of study, yes, my aunt has endometrial cancer with another small complication and, yes, this news has hit us all very hard, including her because her mother (my grandmother) died from cancer despite all the efforts we made at the time to eliminate that disease from her body. > >It is not all bad, because we have the opportunity to perform an operation where they remove everything and the chances of removing the cancer from the root are great enough, as the doctor says that fortunately this bad disease is concentrated in the endometrium and has not spread to other areas, which is really very good and gives some encouragement. > >Below, I share an image of the final result defined by the doctor:
![Imagen de WhatsApp 2024-12-27 a las 16.56.56_16c5b7c1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rosmiapure/23vsou3h8Q2qTxSNmriqXMf9TGqjUKYqfMAnMaA6eyrxA1bxURrS2D9TrVnhQyK7D8znL.jpg)
Afortunadamente, el doctor nos comenta que pueden operarla para extraer todo lo adentro y con esto tener el mayor porcentaje de probabilidad de extraer toda esta enfermedad maligna, ya que al parecer hasta los momentos se encuentra concentrada en el endometrio y no sean expandidos a otras zonas del cuerpo. Es aquí, donde amablemente solicito de su gran apoyo, ya que, el monto del coste de la operación es considerablemente alto y de verdad amigos, todo lo que nos pueda llegar es de gran ayuda porque todo realmente suma. A continuación, comparto imagen del presupuesto: > Fortunately, the doctor tells us that they can operate to remove everything inside and thus have the highest percentage of probability of removing all this malignant disease, since it seems that so far is concentrated in the endometrium and not be expanded to other areas of the body. > >It is here, where I kindly ask for your great support, since the amount of the cost of the operation is considerably high and truly friends, everything that can reach us is of great help because everything really adds up. > >Below, I share a picture of the budget: ![Imagen de WhatsApp 2024-12-27 a las 16.56.56_1c2bbe39.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rosmiapure/23tcLvdYEoEiZCzQ4FxBWXqtESRCe7Cz3aEiKN5vAyhw1pNsGdcTNGmc5x5zaxPqVhEiT.jpg) Todos los montos calculados en ese presupuesto se encuentran expresados en $ y el monto total para costear la operación es de 4.025,00 dólares. Por eso, amigos, estamos solicitando todo el apoyo porque es una cantidad bastante fuerte y, contamos con poco tiempo para lograr reunirlos para hacer la operación lo más pronto posible. Considero que cualquier ayuda o aporte suma, toda ayuda, hasta si pudieran incluir a mi tía en sus oraciones, sería de gran ayuda y es algo que sabremos agradecer mucho. > All the amounts calculated in this budget are expressed in $ and the total amount to pay for the operation is $4,025.00. > >That is why, friends, we are asking for all the support because it is quite a large amount and we have little time to get them together to make the operation as soon as possible. I consider that any help or contribution adds up, any help, even if you could include my aunt in your prayers, it would be of great help and it is something that we will be very grateful for. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rosmiapure/AKSexvViZ9kiVSn7QweuK4dpLU4xRV54KZyiAVFfp6uLV9RiNN2sRvBmXt3dB4m.png) Para este post, cuento con la autorización de mi tía Karmary Sanchez. Las imágenes mostradas aquí me las ha facilitado ella, y la imagen de portada la edité en Canva. > For this post, I have the permission of my aunt Karmary Sanchez. The images shown here were provided by her, and the cover image was edited in Canva.
